title: Show HN: Learn by rebuilding Redis, Git, a database from scratch
summary: A learning platform that teaches programming through hands-on projects where users rebuild popular open-source software like Redis, Git, and databases from scratch, providing deep understanding of how these fundamental tools work internally.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between theoretical programming knowledge and practical understanding by having developers implement real-world tools from scratch.
why_valuable: Project-based learning of foundational systems software helps developers gain deep architectural insights that transfer to everyday development work.
